ruling.escalation_reason: Safety ticket under SAFE-2: rider alleges speeding, hard braking and shoulder overtaking over the 08:36–08:52 NUS→Raffles Place trip, and the driver's post-trip statement uses insulting language ("rider is stupid") toward her, a SAFE-1 abuse issue. No telematics, speed-band or traffic facts exist for the actual route, so the driving allegation is neither corroborated nor refuted; F1/F2 (10.6 km vs 10.7 km; 16.1 min vs 16 min) rule out only route deviation and excess mileage [F1][F2]. Chat is complete and timestamped but contains only pickup logistics and no in-trip safety report [F3][F4][F5]. Fixed $24.76 RydeX fare, no fare/add-on facts, and no refund is claimed, so no amount is computed [F1][FARE-1]. Reviewer should check: any telematics or speed-band record for the actual line, the driver's demeanour/statement [F6], and weigh the absence of an in-trip objection against a complaint first made after drop-off; note 995 / driver commercial motor insurance / RydeHELP reporting routes to the rider.

rejected_claims.reason: The claim that F1's -0.1 km distance record exonerates the driver from the driving allegation misreads the fact: F1 measures route length only, not speed, braking or lane use, and RD-1 is a route-deviation clause with no off-route segment in this file (no gps-detour fact appears); it therefore settles only that there was no excess-mileage deviation, not the SAFE-2 driving question [F1][RD-1].

The claim that F2's 16.1 min vs 16 min duration contradicts the speeding narrative assumes an aggregate average can exclude short bursts of speeding or momentary shoulder use; F2 gives total duration only, and the driver's own brief concedes no telematics exist to disprove such bursts, so F2 is neutral, not exculpatory [F2][SAFE-2].

The claim that the complete chat record shows 'nothing abnormal' overstates it: F3/F4 are logistics only (rider at the main entrance, driver announcing arrival) and are silent on driving, and silence about safety during the ride neither confirms nor refutes the post-trip complaint; the reading is neutral and the driver's hostile statement F6 remains in the file for the reviewer [F3][F4][F5][F6][SAFE-1].

The claim that the absence of fare facts means 'no computable overcharge and no refund' is accepted as far as money goes — the fixed $24.76 RydeX quote with no add-on facts yields no refundable item under FARE-1 — but it cannot be used to dispose of the case, since the trace admits only escalation for a safety ticket [F1][FARE-1][SAFE-2].

The rider's request that no account flag be raised and the driver's withdrawal of any account action are both correct on the profile record: with no route violation made out and 0 disputes / 0 upheld for both parties in 90 d, the RD-6 condition for flag_account is not met, so no account action is added [F7][F8][RD-6].
